name: ITO Etchant (HCl Base)
description: ITO Etchant (HCl Base) is a specialized wet etching solution composed of ferric chloride and hydrochloric acid formulated for precise patterning of Indium Tin Oxide (ITO) transparent conductive films. This formulation is widely used in flat panel display and LED manufacturing for creating transparent electrode patterns. The ferric chloride component acts as the primary oxidizing etchant, while hydrochloric acid maintains the solution pH and prevents re-deposition of etched material. The HCl-based formulation provides controlled etch rates with good uniformity suitable for large-area display substrates. Multiple concentration grades are available to match specific ITO film thicknesses and process integration requirements.
physicalProperties: Appearance: yellow to brown liquid; Density: ~1.2 g/cm³; pH: <1; Boiling Point: >100 °C
